items.known: CKV_AWS_96 Ensure all data stored in Aurora is securely encrypted at rest (resource aws_rds_cluster.app1-rds-cluster)
items.remediation: Add storage_encrypted = true and specify a KMS key via kms_key_id = "<your_kms_key_arn>" to enforce encryption at rest for all cluster data.

items.known: CKV_AWS_139 Ensure that RDS clusters have deletion protection enabled (resource aws_rds_cluster.app1-rds-cluster)
items.remediation: Add deletion_protection = true to the resource block to prevent accidental or unauthorised deletion of the cluster.
